staff_exception_day.name: staff_exception_day
staff_exception_day.where: "app"."schedule_exceptions"."staff_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."schedule_exceptions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

service_duration.name: service_duration
service_duration.value: "app"."services"."duration_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 720 AND "app"."services"."buffer_before_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 240 AND "app"."services"."buffer_after_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 240 AND "app"."services"."duration_minutes"+"app"."services"."buffer_before_minutes"+"app"."services"."buffer_after_minutes"<=1440

appointment_cancellation.name: appointment_cancellation
appointment_cancellation.value: ("app"."appointments"."status"='cancelled' AND "app"."appointments"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(trim("app"."appointments"."cancellation_reason")) BETWEEN 3 AND 300) OR ("app"."appointments"."status"='confirmed' AND "app"."appointments"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "app"."appointments"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL)
